topics: Introduction: Scope and functions of Industrial Engineering - Types of production (batch, flow and unit), Roles of line supervisors and production managers.

Product Development and Design: Objectives - Quality and cost considerations - Human factors in design - Detailed design & prototyping - Functionality & manufacturability - Standardization, simplification and variety reduction - Concurrent engineering.
Plant layout and Material handling: Types of plant layout - Principles of material handling - Material handling equipment – Types, selection and application.
Production Planning and Control: Aggregate production planning, materials requirement planning - Inventory Management: EOQ models, discount models,
P system, Q system, reorder level – Selective inventory control techniques - JIT - Supply chain and management.
Break down, preventive and predictive maintenance.
Lean Manufacturing (LM): Basic elements – Tools - Concept of wastes - stages of 5S and waste elimination - Need for LM.
Agile manufacturing: Definition, business need, conceptual frame work, characteristics and generic features - Approaches to enhance agility in manufacturing - Managing people in agile organization.

Enterprise resource planning (ERP): Concept of Enterprise, ERP Overview - Integrated information system - ERP implementation – Benefits, challenges, success and failure factors - Business Process Reengineering (BPR), Customer relationship management (CRM).
Quality Management: Quality, quality planning, quality control, quality assurance, quality management – TQM, ISO, Six Sigma and Quality circle (Brief description only).

Statistical Quality Control - Process capability - Causes of variation in quality- Control charts for 
  and R – Acceptance sampling.
Reliability Engineering - Causes of failures - Bath tub curve - System reliability - Life testing.
